description: Three vertebrae still loosely strung together. Gravecharger sheds them and does not slow down.
lore: Boil the gristle off, run a cord through the holes, and a spine becomes the cheapest counter anybody ever made: one bone pushed down the string for each night kept. [[characters/cfe826c1|Jehanne]] has used the same one since she took up the rite — a short string, nine bones, because nine was the length of the rota she was handed and it has never been revised down for her. She pushes one along after the candles are out. When the ninth goes she runs them all back to the top and starts again, and she has done that more times than she has a number for, on a rota that has not had nine keepers on it in a very long time. Ten gold buys you the string. What you count on it afterwards is your own business.
gm_notes: The rota made into an object. Jehanne keeping a nine-place count for a rota with far fewer keepers is the Thinning stated without stating it.
